nativeBoard.title: Native records · fastest first
nativeBoard.policy: Public outdoor cycling recorded by ORider. Indoor, e-bike, duplicate, deleted and implausible efforts are excluded. Only currently accessible records are compared; this is not a global KOM or a global participant ranking. Records are fastest first, excluding subsequent records by the same rider. Scope members are not a participant count.

safeLegend.title: Local Legend
safeLegend.intro: Compare completions from public native rides over 13 weeks including this week.
safeLegend.criteria: The window starts on a Korean-time Monday, 13 weeks including this week. Only authorized current native outdoor cycling records count; duplicate records of the same activity count once. A minimum of 3 completions is required; ties favor the earliest completion in the window. This compares currently accessible riders, not all riders.
